claim: A published low-voltage-loss OSC example (PTO2:Y1) shows a measured FF of 0.27 versus a transport-and-bimolecular-recombination-only reconstructed FF of 0.58; the resulting FF retention is about 0.466. This is an external material-system benchmark, not a D18/PY-IT/eC9 threshold or measurement.

source.title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
source.source_location: Main text, FF and VOC section; PTO2:Y1 discussion around Table 1 and field-dependent charge generation section

ff_measured.note: Published main-text value; no measurement uncertainty attached to this scalar in the inspected passage. ±0.005 is only a rounding-resolution interval implied by two-decimal reporting, not physical uncertainty.

ff_transport_reconstructed.note: Authors' reconstructed FF expected if limited only by transport and bimolecular recombination, as described in the inspected main text.

eta_int_open_circuit.note: Reported for PTO2:Y1 in the field-dependent-generation model discussion; retained as provenance context and not used in the scalar FF-retention calculation.

beta.note: Reported for PTO2:Y1; retained as provenance context and not used in the scalar FF-retention calculation.

validity_domain: Arithmetic benchmark only. It quantifies the gap between two values reported by Zhang et al. for PTO2:Y1. It does not independently validate the authors' causal attribution, does not transfer the parameters to D18/PY-IT/eC9, and does not provide a project acceptance threshold.
falsifier: Revise or retire this benchmark if the cited source values are corrected, if a source-version mismatch is found, or if the 0.58 quantity is shown not to represent the transport/bimolecular-only reconstructed FF described in the main text.
